string.src: To pair this system with your PC, enter the PIN shown below in Sunshine.
On your PC, open the Sunshine Web UI and select [PIN]. Enter the number shown below, then confirm pairing.
Swap X and O sent to PC
Swaps the A/B buttons sent by X/O to the PC. Does not change Moonlight navigation. Ignored when custom face-button mapping is enabled. Takes effect on the next stream.
Shows the game's controller light color over the stream: a small bottom light or soft side lights. Requires RGB feedback from the host gamepad. Takes effect on the next stream.
Settings are stored by the Vita AppSettings service.

Requests game graphics adjustments on the PC for the selected resolution and FPS, when supported by the host. Takes effect on the next stream.
Helps video recovery after lost or corrupted packets by invalidating unusable reference frames.
On: automatically detects local or remote connections from the host address. Off: forces local LAN mode. Takes effect on the next stream.
Waits for the Vita display VBlank when presenting video frames. This can reduce tearing, but may affect latency and frame pacing.
Limits presentation to the selected FPS by dropping excess decoded frames when they arrive too quickly.
Requests audio playback through the PC's speakers or headphones when supported by the host. Takes effect on the next stream.

Video: resolution, codec, target FPS and video payload bitrate (Mbps). FPS: received, decoded and submitted to PAF; PAF is not the physical display rate. RTT/variation: round-trip network delay and its fluctuation (ms). Drops: frames missing before decoding, skipped by the pacer or replaced in the PAF queue (%). Decode call/PAF queue: average decoder call time and queue wait (ms). Host min/max/avg: PC processing time (ms), when available. Video stalled: no recent frames. Unavailable measurements are hidden.
On: fills the Vita screen and crops edges when the aspect ratios differ. Off: fits the entire image.
Enables diagnostic messages in psp2shell. No log file is written.
Sends the Vita gyroscope and accelerometer data to the PC as motion input.
Swaps the functions of R1/L1 with R2/L2.
Sets the two-finger scroll speed in Mouse Absolute mode. Higher multipliers scroll faster; cursor speed is unchanged.
Captures the Vita PS button during streaming. A single press is sent to the PC as a PS/Xbox button; a double press stops the stream. Hold to open Vita Quick Actions.
Only active when Touchscreen mode is Off. Top left: keyboard; top right: stop stream (also works without PS button capture); bottom left: L3; bottom right: R3.
Selects how the Vita front touchscreen is presented to the host: off, DS4-style touchpad, absolute mouse, or Sunshine tablet mode.
Loads Cross, Circle, Square and Triangle mappings from ux0:data/moonlight/vita.conf. Overrides the X/O swap setting. Takes effect on the next stream.
Reserves a margin along this back-touchscreen edge, in pixels of the virtual 960x544 touch area. Higher values move the active area inward.
